### Setup gates


```{r try to work through the gating}
gateList = data.frame(flowJoName = nodelist)

# write to csv so I can open in excel and figure out a pattern
write.csv(gateList, file = "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/tables_RG_2025_05/CyTOF_gateList.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# str split flowJoName by "/" and take the last element
gateList$node = sapply(strsplit(gateList$flowJoName, "/"), function(x) x[length(x)])
gateList$parent = sapply(strsplit(gateList$flowJoName, "/"), function(x) paste0(x[1:(length(x) - 1)], collapse = "/"))
gateList$parent[gateList$parent == ""] = "root"


gateList = dplyr::filter(gateList, flowJoName != "/CD16+")
# cd3+ also seems to be dangling
gateList = dplyr::filter(gateList, flowJoName != "/CD14-CD19-/CD3+")

gateList = dplyr::filter(gateList, node != "root")

```


```{r get gates and transformations}
# get the controls
samples = data.frame(flowJoName = sampleNames(gs_flowJo) )
# remove the _95977 from exp_D_MN_B04_IC04.fcs_95977, etc
samples$fcsName = gsub(".fcs_.*", ".fcs", samples$flowJoName)

samples = merge(samples, design, by = "fcsName")

table(samples$batch)

samples = samples[order(samples$batch),]

```

```{r generate gate and transformer lists}
# start building out gates

gates = list()
trans = list()


for (iControl in 1:nrow(samples)) {
  batch_ = samples$batch[iControl]
  
  #Get the gates for this condition and batch
  gates_ = list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(gateList)) {
    gates_[[i]] = gs_pop_get_gate(gs_flowJo, gateList$flowJoName[i])[[iControl]]
  }
  gates[[batch_]] = gates_
  
  # Get transformations for this condition and batch
  trans_ = gh_get_transformations(gs_flowJo[[iControl]])
  trans[[batch_]] <- transformList(from = names(trans_), trans_)
}

```


```{r correctly handling the special gates}
gates_ = gates[[1]]
# This time, there are several different types of not gates:
# - e.g. CD14-CD19- this is not a logical gate, instead this a normal rectangular gate it seems
gates_[[2]]
# - e.g. DR+11c+- this is a logical gate, not !DR+11c+. 
gates_[[3]]
gates_[[4]]
# However, notice how it negates the entire "node": !CD14-CD19-/DR+11c+. We will have to change this expression to !DR+11c+



# Or gates
gates_[[17]]
# This is an or gate, unfortunately, it uses expression for the entire note path as well. So we will need to have to fix these as well
gates_[[30]]
# We can probably split those gates at the "or" character and then build the expression for them

# One thing that appears to be different to our previous run is that we do not need to add additional negative gates, so that is good!

gateList$dependsOn = NA

gateList = as.data.frame(gateList)

# Approach:
# Loop over the gates, identify the ones that end in "-", and replace the entire expression with the last element of the path
for (iGate in 1:nrow(gateList)) {
  if (!str_detect(gateList$node[iGate], "\\-$")) {next} # skip if doesn't end with -
  if (class(gates[[1]][[iGate]]) != "booleanFilter") {next} # skip if it is not a logical gate, use the first batch to validate that
  
  filterId = gateList$node[iGate]
  # remove the last character
  if (str_detect(gateList$node[iGate], "\\+\\-$")) {
    filterIdpos = substr(filterId, 1, nchar(filterId) - 1)
  } else {
    filterIdpos = str_replace(gateList$node[iGate], "\\-$", "+")
  }
  
  # Build the not gate
  exprs <- paste0("!", filterIdpos)
  gate_ = eval(substitute(booleanFilter(v, filterId = w), list(v = as.symbol(exprs), w = filterId)))
  
  for (iBatch in 1:length(gates)) {
    gates[[iBatch]][[iGate]] = gate_
  }
  
  
  # add gates this gates depends 
  gateList$dependsOn[iGate] = which(gateList$node == filterIdpos & gateList$parent == gateList$parent[iGate])
  
}

# Now, fix the or gates:
for (iGate in 1:nrow(gateList)) {
  if (!str_detect(gateList$node[iGate], "or")) {next} # skip if doesn't contain key word or
  if (class(gates[[1]][[iGate]]) != "booleanFilter") {next} # skip if it is not a logical gate
  
  filterId = gateList$node[iGate]
  # remove the last character
  parents = str_split(filterId, " or ")[[1]]
  
  # Build the or gate
  exprs <- paste0(parents, collapse = "|")
  gate_ = eval(substitute(booleanFilter(v, filterId = w), list(v = as.symbol(exprs), w = filterId)))
  
  for (iBatch in 1:length(gates)) {
    gates[[iBatch]][[iGate]] = gate_
  }
  
  gateList$dependsOn[iGate] = list(which(gateList$node %in% parents & gateList$parent == gateList$parent[iGate]))
}

```



### Do gating
```{r come up with what we need to gate}
# after reexport of the cytof data, alice added multiple new paths
# these are the ones we want to gate for:
# CD14-CD19-/DR+11c+-/pDC-/CD3+/NKT-/TCRgd-/CD4+/Treg-/RA+/Q1: 155Gd_CD62L- , 167Er_CD27+ or Q2: 155Gd_CD62L+ , 167Er_CD27+/Tscm
# CD14-CD19-/DR+11c+-/pDC-/CD3+/NKT-/TCRgd-/CD8+/RA+-/Q2: 155Gd_CD62L+ , 167Er_CD27+
# CD14-CD19-/DR+11c+-/pDC-/CD3+/NKT-/TCRgd-/CD8+/RA+/Q1: 155Gd_CD62L- , 167Er_CD27+ or Q2: 155Gd_CD62L+ , 167Er_CD27+/Tscm
# /CD14-CD19-/DR+11c+-/pDC-/CD3+/NKT-/TCRgd-/CD4+/Treg-/RA+-/Q2: 155Gd_CD62L+ , 167Er_CD27+
# If we gate for these nodes, we should also cover all the other nodes that alice exported as they are part of those paths

paths = list()
paths[[1]] = as.vector(str_split("CD14-CD19-/DR+11c+-/pDC-/CD3+/NKT-/TCRgd-/CD4+/Treg-/RA+/Q1: 155Gd_CD62L- , 167Er_CD27+ or Q2: 155Gd_CD62L+ , 167Er_CD27+/Tscm", "/", simplify = TRUE))
paths[[2]] = as.vector(str_split("CD14-CD19-/DR+11c+-/pDC-/CD3+/NKT-/TCRgd-/CD8+/RA+-/Q2: 155Gd_CD62L+ , 167Er_CD27+", "/", simplify = TRUE))
paths[[3]] = as.vector(str_split("CD14-CD19-/DR+11c+-/pDC-/CD3+/NKT-/TCRgd-/CD8+/RA+/Q1: 155Gd_CD62L- , 167Er_CD27+ or Q2: 155Gd_CD62L+ , 167Er_CD27+/Tscm", "/", simplify = TRUE))
paths[[4]] = as.vector(str_split("CD14-CD19-/DR+11c+-/pDC-/CD3+/NKT-/TCRgd-/CD4+/Treg-/RA+-/Q2: 155Gd_CD62L+ , 167Er_CD27+", "/", simplify = TRUE))


# Instead of splitting it up and gating shared features first, I am going to implement a check to see if the gate to be added already exists, and then will skip it

```


```{r gate all the gates amber gave us}
# this is a bit different than in previous iterations - now, instead of going by "hierarchical" and 
# "leafs" I am going to just step through sequentially

# Let's add celltype so we can distinguish ambiguous gates
gateList$cellType = ifelse(str_detect(gateList$flowJoName, "CD4"), "CD4", 
                           ifelse(str_detect(gateList$flowJoName, "CD8"), "CD8", NA))

# Also add RA information
gateList$RA = ifelse(str_detect(gateList$flowJoName, "RA\\+-"), "RA+-", 
                     ifelse(str_detect(gateList$flowJoName, "RA\\+(?!-)"), "RA+", NA))


add_new_node_workspace = function(gs, node, gate, parent) {
  if (parent == "root") {
    nodeToAdd = paste0("/", node)
  } else {
    nodeToAdd = paste0(parent, "/", node)
  }
  
  existingNodes = gs_get_pop_paths(gs, path = "full")

  if (nodeToAdd %in% existingNodes) {return (nodeToAdd)}

  gs_pop_add(gs, gate, parent = parent)

  return(nodeToAdd)
}

# RA/cellType/parent-aware resolver to pick the correct gate index
.pick_node_idx <- function(nm, parent_path, gateList, prev_idx = NA_integer_) {
  cand <- which(gateList$node == nm)
  if (length(cand) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  if (length(cand) == 1) return(cand)

  # Derive contextual hints from parent_path
  cellType_ <- ifelse(str_detect(parent_path, "CD4"), "CD4",
               ifelse(str_detect(parent_path, "CD8"), "CD8", NA))
  RA_ <- ifelse(str_detect(parent_path, "RA\\+-"), "RA+-",
         ifelse(str_detect(parent_path, "RA\\+(?!-)"), "RA+", NA))

  if (!is.na(cellType_)) cand <- cand[gateList$cellType[cand] == cellType_]
  if (length(cand) == 1) return(cand)

  if (!is.na(RA_))       cand <- cand[gateList$RA[cand] == RA_]
  if (length(cand) == 1) return(cand)

  # Prefer a candidate that lists prev_idx in dependsOn
  if (!is.na(prev_idx)) {
    dep_hits <- vapply(cand, function(i) {
      di <- gateList$dependsOn[[i]]
      if (is.null(di)) return(FALSE)
      if (is.character(di)) return(FALSE)
      prev_idx %in% unlist(di, use.names = FALSE)
    }, logical(1))
    if (sum(dep_hits) >= 1) return(cand[which(dep_hits)][1])
  }

  # Last resort: prefer exact parent match if available
  ph <- which(gateList$parent[cand] == parent_path)
  if (length(ph) >= 1) return(cand[ph[1]])

  # Deterministic fallback
  cand[1]
}


# gate the shared path (using resolver + prev_idx to avoid RA/duplicate mixups)
for (iPath in seq_along(paths)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    parent   = "root"
    prev_idx = NA_integer_
    
    for (i in seq_along(paths[[iPath]])) {
      nm <- paths[[iPath]][i]
      
      # Resolve the correct gate row for this node given current parent context
      iGate <- .pick_node_idx(nm, parent, gateList, prev_idx)
      if (is.na(iGate)) {
        stop(paste0("Could not resolve gate for node '", nm, "' under parent '", parent, "'"))
      }
      
      # Add any declared dependencies first (do NOT advance parent on deps)
      if (!is.na(gateList$dependsOn[iGate])) {
        additionalGates <- unlist(gateList$dependsOn[iGate])
        for (dep in additionalGates) {
          if (is.character(dep)) {
            dep_idx <- .pick_node_idx(dep, parent, gateList, prev_idx)
            if (is.na(dep_idx)) stop(paste0("Dependency '", dep, "' could not be resolved under parent '", parent, "'"))
          } else {
            dep_idx <- gateList$idx[dep]
          }
          # Add dependency node under the current parent (parent remains unchanged)
          add_new_node_workspace(gs[[batch_]], gateList$node[dep_idx], gates[[batch_]][[dep_idx]], parent)
          # We update prev_idx to the last successfully added gate index to help future disambiguation
          prev_idx <- dep_idx
        }
      }
      
      # Now add the actual node
      idx    <- gateList$idx[iGate]
      parent <- add_new_node_workspace(gs[[batch_]], gateList$node[iGate], gates[[batch_]][[idx]], parent)
      prev_idx <- idx
    }
  }
}

```

```{r try to work through the gating}
gateList$type = "hierarchical"
```

```{r get gates and transformations}
# get the controls
samples = data.frame(flowJoName = sampleNames(gs_flowJo) )
# remove the _95977 from exp_D_MN_B04_IC04.fcs_95977, etc

table(samples$batch)
```

```{r generate gate and transformer lists}
# start building out gates

# IMPORTANT: the first time I ran the evaluation I had issues with the not gates. I will correctly handle them in the next section. HOWEVER - the big problem is how they are coming out of the workspace, eg. NKT in the gating paths should actually be NKT- and the gate that has filterId NKT is actually NKT+! So I am going to have to fix the gate names in the gating objects, but more importantly, we will have to replace all the NKTs in paths to NKT-. And it gets even worse TCRgd+ in the gating paths is actually TCRgd- and the gate that has filterId TCRgd+ is actually TCRgd+! So I will have to fix that as well. 

gatesModifiers = list()
transModifiers = list()


for (iControl in 1:nrow(samples)) {
  batch_ = samples$batch[iControl]
  
  #Get the gates for this condition and batch
  gates_ = list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(gateListModifiers)) {
    gates_[[i]] = gs_pop_get_gate(gs_flowJo, gateListModifiers$flowJoName[i])[[iControl]]
  }
  gatesModifiers[[batch_]] = gates_
  
  # Get transformations for this condition and batch
  trans_ = gh_get_transformations(gs_flowJo[[iControl]])
  transModifiers[[batch_]] <- transformList(from = names(trans_), trans_)
}

```

```{r correctly handling the special gates}
gates_ = gatesModifiers[[1]]

gates_

gateListModifiers$dependsOn = NA

rownames(gateListModifiers) = NULL
gateListModifiers$idx = 1:nrow(gateListModifiers)
```

```{r setup gating sets}
# After organizing the gates, we need to organize the fcs files into gating sets
# instead of making folders and using symboling links (cyto_setup needs a folder to read files in)
# let's see if we can build the gs objects with flowCore (flowSet() and GatingSet() )

gs = list()

for (batch_ in sort(unique(design$batch))) {
  samples_ = dplyr::filter(design, batch == batch_)
  # add a second filtering step to only keep files that amber tested on
  samples_ = dplyr::filter(samples_, fcsName %in% countsReference$sample)
  
  
  print(paste0(" batch: ", batch_, " samples: ", nrow(samples_)))
  flowSet = read.flowSet(samples_$transformedFcs,
                         truncate_max_range = FALSE)
  
  gs[[batch_]] = GatingSet(flowSet)
}
```

### Do gating


```{r gate all the gates amber gave us}
# this is a bit different than in previous iterations - now, instead of going by "hierarchical" and 
# "leafs" I am going to just step through sequentially


# gate the shared path
for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
  parent = "root"
  for (i in 1:nrow(gateListModifiers) ) {

    idx = gateListModifiers$idx[i]
    gs_pop_add(gs[[batch_]], gatesModifiers[[batch_]][[idx]], parent = parent)
  }
}
```

```{r create additional gates}
# All gates are either just the boolean version of the + version of the gate, and one bigger NOT gate, so I can simplify things a bit compared to what I did for the hierarchical gating when I fixed the boolean gates

# Build any gates missing from FlowJo to satisfy root vocab
for (iGate in seq_along(missingGates)) {
  filterId <- missingGates[iGate]

  # Helper: resolve a node label to "dependsOn" (leave as character labels so
  # getRootPathTcells can RA-resolve at runtime)
  as_dep <- function(lbls) {
    if (is.character(lbls)) return(lbls)
    return(lbls)
  }

  # CASE 1: "NOT <something>"
  if (str_detect(filterId, "^NOT ")) {
    pos <- str_replace(filterId, "^NOT ", "")

    #    # 1a) NOT (A or B or C...)  ->  (!A) & (!B) & (!C)
    if (str_detect(pos, " or ")) {
      parts <- str_split(pos, " or ", simplify = TRUE)[1, ]
      # Build as conjunction of individual NOTs to avoid '(' tokens
      exprs <- paste(paste0("!", parts), collapse = "&")
      gate_ <- eval(substitute(booleanFilter(v, filterId = w),
                               list(v = as.symbol(exprs), w = filterId)))
      # Append to all batches
      for (iBatch in seq_along(gatesAll)) {
        gatesAll[[iBatch]][[length(gatesAll[[iBatch]]) + 1]] <- gate_
      }
      # Register in gateListAll
      newGate <- data.frame(node = filterId, idx = nrow(gateListAll) + 1,
                            dependsOn = NA, type = "boolean")
      gateListAll <- bind_rows(gateListAll, newGate)
      gateListAll$dependsOn[[nrow(gateListAll)]] <- parts  # depend on raw part labels
      next
    }


    # 1b) Simple NOT X  (existing behavior)
    filterIdpos <- pos
    exprs <- paste0("!", filterIdpos)
    gate_ <- eval(substitute(booleanFilter(v, filterId = w),
                             list(v = as.symbol(exprs), w = filterId)))
    for (iBatch in seq_along(gatesAll)) {
      gatesAll[[iBatch]][[length(gatesAll[[iBatch]]) + 1]] <- gate_
    }
    newGate <- data.frame(node = filterId, idx = nrow(gateListAll) + 1,
                          dependsOn = NA, type = "boolean")
    gateListAll <- bind_rows(gateListAll, newGate)
    gateListAll$dependsOn[[nrow(gateListAll)]] <- as_dep(filterIdpos)
    next
  }

  # CASE 2: trailing "-" (boolean inversion of a "+" or a bare marker)
  if (str_detect(filterId, "\\-$")) {
    filterIdpos <- if (str_detect(filterId, "\\+\\-$")) {
      substr(filterId, 1, nchar(filterId) - 1)
    } else {
      str_replace(filterId, "\\-$", "+")
    }
    # If the "+” version truly doesn't exist (e.g., Tscm-), invert the bare token
    if (!(filterIdpos %in% gateListAll$node)) {
      filterIdpos <- str_replace(filterId, "\\-$", "")
    }
    gate_ <- eval(substitute(booleanFilter(v, filterId = w),
                             list(v = as.symbol(paste0("!", filterIdpos)), w = filterId)))
    for (iBatch in seq_along(gatesAll)) {
      gatesAll[[iBatch]][[length(gatesAll[[iBatch]]) + 1]] <- gate_
    }
    newGate <- data.frame(node = filterId, idx = nrow(gateListAll) + 1,
                          dependsOn = NA, type = "boolean")
    gateListAll <- bind_rows(gateListAll, newGate)
    gateListAll$dependsOn[[nrow(gateListAll)]] <- as_dep(filterIdpos)
    next
  }

  # CASE 3: plain "A or B" (rare in roots now, but supported)
  if (str_detect(filterId, " or ")) {
    parts <- str_split(filterId, " or ", simplify = TRUE)[1, ]
    exprs <- paste(parts, collapse = "|")
    gate_ <- eval(substitute(booleanFilter(v, filterId = w),
                             list(v = as.symbol(exprs), w = filterId)))
    for (iBatch in seq_along(gatesAll)) {
      gatesAll[[iBatch]][[length(gatesAll[[iBatch]]) + 1]] <- gate_
    }
    newGate <- data.frame(node = filterId, idx = nrow(gateListAll) + 1,
                          dependsOn = NA, type = "boolean")
    gateListAll <- bind_rows(gateListAll, newGate)
    gateListAll$dependsOn[[nrow(gateListAll)]] <- as_dep(parts)
    next
  }

  # (No other synthetic shapes are supported—FlowJo must supply rectangle gates.)
}
```

```{r run on a single batch and rootpath for now}
batch_ = 8
path_ = 58

recompute(gs[[batch_]])
x = gs_pop_get_count_fast(gs[[batch_]], format = "long")



rootPath = str_split(rootPaths$path[path_], "/")[[1]]
modifierNodes = dplyr::filter(gateListAll, type == "modifier")
modifierNodes = dplyr::filter(modifierNodes, !(node %in% rootPath))
if (str_detect(rootPaths$path[path_], "CD27")) {
  modifierNodes = dplyr::filter(modifierNodes, node != "CD27+")
}

# make a list modifierGates, which uses the entries in gatesAll[[batch_]][idx] where idx is the index of the modifierNodes
modifierGates = gatesAll[[batch_]][modifierNodes$idx]
names(modifierGates) = modifierNodes$node


gatemetadata = data.frame(name = modifierNodes$node,
                          gate_type = "2D",
                          marker1 = NA,
                          marker2 = NA,
                          original_gate_position = NA,
                          logical_gate = FALSE,
                          transformed_gate_position = NA)


# --- NEW: prune modifiers that are missing/invalid in this batch ---
ok <- vapply(modifierGates, function(g) !is.null(g) && inherits(g, "filter"), logical(1))

if (any(!ok)) {
  dropped <- modifierNodes$name[!ok]
  message("Dropping ", sum(!ok), " invalid modifier gate(s) in batch ", batch_, ": ",
          paste(dropped, collapse = ", "))
  modifierNodes <- modifierNodes[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  modifierGates <- modifierGates[ok]
  gatemetadata  <- gatemetadata[ok, , drop = FALSE]
}

# If nothing left, skip level-2 gating for this batch to avoid crash
if (length(modifierGates) == 0L) {
  message("No valid modifier gates for batch ", batch_, " — skipping level2Gating for this batch.")
} else {
  level2_paths = level2Gating(
    gs[[batch_]],
    modifierNodes$node, gatemetadata, modifierGates,
    paste0("/", rootPaths$path[path_]),
    max_depth = 3,
    level1_nodes = modifierNodes$node,
    cellcountCutoff = 0
  )
}
```

```{r process paths}

# combine with design
counts = merge(counts, design, by.x = "name", by.y = "fcsName")
# rename column name to fcsName
colnames(counts)[colnames(counts) == "name"] = "fcsName"
counts = dplyr::filter(counts, control == FALSE)

# extract the populations
nodes = data.frame(path = unique(counts$Population))

nodes = processGatingPaths(nodes, max_depth = 3)

nodes = assignRoot(nodes, rootPaths$path[path_])
nodes$pathInCompartment = str_remove(nodes$pathInCompartment, "^/")

nodes$subset = paste(rootPaths$name[path_], nodes$pathInCompartment, sep = "/")
# remove trailing / from subset
nodes$subset = str_remove(nodes$subset, "/$")

nodes$subset[is.na(nodes$rootPath)] = NA


counts = merge(counts, nodes, by.x = "Population", by.y = "path")
# this is also going to remove all of the AIM+ nodes that we didn't use
```

```{r run only the 24 corrected roots}
# 1) Your 24 target roots as underscore names (do not edit spelling)
targets_underscore <- c(
  # "CD4Teff_CentralMemory",
  # "CD4Teff_CentralMemory_Th1_17",
  # "CD4Teff_CentralMemory_Th1",
  # "CD4Teff_CentralMemory_Th17",
  #"CD4Teff_CentralMemory_Th2",
  #"CD4Teff_TEMRA",
  #"CD4Teff_TEMRA_Th1_17",
  #"CD4Teff_TEMRA_Th1",
  #"CD4Teff_TEMRA_Th17",
  #"CD4Teff_TEMRA_Th2",
  # "CD4TFH_CentralMemory",
  # "CD4TFH_CentralMemory_Th1_17",
  # "CD4TFH_CentralMemory_Th1",
  # "CD4TFH_CentralMemory_Th17",
  # "CD4TFH_CentralMemory_Th2",
  #"CD4TFH_TEMRA_Th1_17",
  #"CD4TFH_TEMRA_Th1",
  #"CD4TFH_TEMRA_Th17",
  #"CD4TFH_TEMRA_Th2",
  #"CD4TFH_TEMRA",
 # "CD4Treg_CentralMemory",
  "CD4Treg_TEMRA",
  #"CD8Teff_CentralMemory",
  "CD8Teff_TEMRA"
)

# 2) Map underscore names to rootPaths$name (which use "/")
#    We'll normalize rootPaths$name by replacing "/" -> "_" and match.
rp_norm <- setNames(gsub("/", "_", rootPaths$name, fixed = TRUE), rootPaths$name)

# Which of the requested targets are present?
present_mask <- targets_underscore %in% rp_norm
if (any(!present_mask)) {
  warning("These requested roots were not found in rootPaths$name (after normalization): ",
          paste(targets_underscore[!present_mask], collapse = ", "))
}

# 3) Get the corresponding indices in rootPaths for the ones that exist
wanted_slash_names <- names(rp_norm)[match(targets_underscore[present_mask], rp_norm)]
idx <- match(wanted_slash_names, rootPaths$name)
idx <- unique(idx[!is.na(idx)])

message("Will gate and save ", length(idx), " root(s).")

# 4) Run gateAndSave() for each target root
for (path_ in idx) {
  print(paste0(">>> Running: ", rootPaths$name[path_]))
  gateAndSave(path_)
}                                                             

message("Done. The                       24 corrected artifacts should be in:\n",         
        "  raw counts:    "          , rawCountsDir, "\n",
        "  processed Rdata:", processedCountsDir)
```                               
